item.description: The Lynceus pulled a folded lead tablet out of a child's grave in Pagasae & the Agora: Thrasgenes #7010 the Turncoat had written Ersion #1727 the Twice-Born's name on it, with the words "I bind Ersion #1727 the Twice-Born, the tongue, the hands, the work".
